episodes.logline: On her wedding night, Meera is thrown out of the Raichand mansion when her father is accused of fraud, and her groom stays silent.

blocks.text: Shehnai music stops mid-note. A ceremonial plate clatters to the floor.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Stop this wedding. Now."
Close on Meera's hennaed hands, frozen above the sacred fire.
Savitri tears the marigold garland from Arjun's neck and throws it into the fire.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Maaji? What are you doing?"

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Saving my son from marrying the daughter of a thief."
She slaps a newspaper onto the mandap. Headline: SHARMA TEXTILES BANKRUPT. OWNER CHARGED WITH FRAUD.

blocks.speaker: GUEST
blocks.text: "Fraud? On the wedding day?"

blocks.speaker: MR. SHARMA
blocks.text: "Savitri-ji, those papers are false. I never signed them, I swear on my daughter."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Your signature is on every page, Sharma-ji. The whole city has read it."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Arjun, tell her. You know my father."
Arjun looks at the floor. His jaw tightens. He says nothing.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Look at her. Still waiting for my son to save her."
Savitri slaps Meera hard across the face. The glass bangles on Meera's wrist crack.
The crack of the slap echoes through the silent hall.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "You can hit me. Don't you touch my father's name."

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Enough! Nobody slaps my sister. Nobody!"
Bunty charges at Savitri, trips over the bride's train and lands face-first in the five-tier wedding cake.
A wet, heavy splat.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "I meant to do that. This is a protest cake."

blocks.speaker: GUEST
blocks.text: "Someone get the protester a spoon."
Mr. Sharma clutches his chest and sways. The crowd parts.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Papa!"
Mr. Sharma collapses onto the marble steps. Meera falls to her knees beside him.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Somebody call a doctor! Please, somebody help him!"

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Take your father and leave my house before the police take him for you."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Arjun. Say something. One word, and I'll believe you."
Slow push in on Arjun. He finally looks up at her.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Go home, Meera."
A single drumbeat. Then silence.
Meera pulls off her wedding dupatta and lays it at Arjun's feet.
Wide shot: guests file out past the overturned flower arches.
Savitri slips into a dark study and shuts the door behind her.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "It's done. The papers you forged worked. Not one person doubted them."
Behind a pillar, Bunty, still covered in cake, freezes with his phone camera pointed at the gap in the door.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Forged? Oh, Bunty. You just recorded something very big."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Burn the originals tonight. Sharma will rot in jail without his good name."
Bunty's phone gives two loud low-battery beeps.
Savitri spins toward the door. Bunty ducks and bolts down the corridor.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Who's there?"
An empty hallway. Only a trail of white cream on the floor.
Thunder. Rain hammers the gravel.
Meera stands at the gate in her soaked bridal lehenga, holding up her barely conscious father.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "I will come back to this house. And every one of you will bow."
A black car with tinted windows glides out of the dark and stops beside her.
The rear window lowers. Only a gloved hand is visible.

blocks.speaker: STRANGER
blocks.text: "Get in, Miss Sharma. If you want your father to live past tonight."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Who are you?"

blocks.speaker: STRANGER
blocks.text: "Someone who knows who really signed those papers."
Meera looks back at the mansion's glowing windows, then opens the car door.

blocks.speaker: MR. SHARMA
blocks.text: "Beta... who is that man?"
The car pulls away. Its tail lights vanish into the rain.
The engine fades. Only the rain is left.

episodes.logline: Five years later, the girl the Raichands threw out walks into their boardroom as its new owner, and she is not alone.

blocks.text: A glass tower against a hard blue sky. Title card: FIVE YEARS LATER.
Meera, in a plain cotton kurta, waits at the reception desk with a slim folder.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "You. Yes, you. Why is my coffee cold?"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "I think you have me confused with someone."

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "In that kurta? Darling, you're either the cleaner or the cleaner's mother."
Tanya tips her full cup of coffee over Meera's white shoes.
Coffee splashes onto marble.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Oops. Clean it."
Close on Meera's face: not hurt. Amused.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Madam! Madam, the board is waiting. Oh no. Your shoes!"

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Madam? Her? Is the cleaner your boss too?"

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Madam, shall I fire her before lunch or after? I have a pen ready."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "After lunch, Bunty. Let her enjoy her last coffee."

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Fire me? Do you know who my fiancé is?"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Arjun Raichand. I know him better than you do."
Meera steps out of the coffee-stained shoes and walks barefoot to the lift.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "How does she know Arjun?"
The lift doors close on Meera's reflection.
Arjun sits at the head of a long table. The directors look grim.

blocks.speaker: DIRECTOR
blocks.text: "We are four hundred crore in debt, Arjun. The bank called in every loan this morning."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "The Raichand Group has survived worse. Who is this buyer everyone is so afraid of?"

blocks.speaker: DIRECTOR
blocks.text: "M.S. Holdings. They bought our debt overnight. They own us now."
The boardroom doors swing open.
Meera walks in barefoot, Bunty behind her carrying a leather file.
Savitri's teacup slips from her fingers.
Porcelain shatters on the floor.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Meera?"

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Meera... you're alive."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Alive, and the majority owner of M.S. Holdings. Meera Sharma Holdings."

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "M for Meera. S for Sharma. We paid a lot for that logo."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "This is my husband's company. Get out before I call security."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Security works for me now, Maaji."
Meera takes the chair at the head of the table. Arjun stands, speechless.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "First decision of the new board. Mrs. Savitri Raichand, you are removed from every post. Effective now."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "You'll pay for this, you little nobody."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "I already paid, five years ago. In the rain. At your gate."
Savitri storms out. Arjun stares at Meera as if she were a stranger.
Meera steps into the lift. Arjun slips in just before the doors shut.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Why did you come back?"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "To take back everything your family took from mine."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "I looked for you, Meera. For months. You vanished."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "You didn't look that night. That was the only night that mattered."
The lift chimes.
The doors open. A small boy in a school uniform runs straight to Meera.

blocks.speaker: KABIR
blocks.text: "Mumma! Bunty mama got me ice cream!"
Arjun looks down. On the boy's wrist: a crescent-shaped birthmark.
Insert: the same crescent birthmark on Arjun's own wrist.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Meera... how old is he?"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Old enough to ask who his father is."
She walks out with the boy. The lift doors begin to close on Arjun.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Whose son is he?"
The doors slam shut.

episodes.logline: Arjun secretly tests whether Kabir is his son, while Meera finds a torn page in her father's diary that leads her into a trap.

blocks.text: Arjun hands a sealed envelope to a doctor: a strand of hair and a used juice straw.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "I need the result by tonight. Nobody, not even my mother, can know."

blocks.speaker: DOCTOR
blocks.text: "A paternity test usually takes three days, Mr. Raichand."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Then buy the lab three more machines. Tonight."
At the end of the corridor, Tanya lowers her phone. She has heard everything.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Aunty, it's worse than we thought. Arjun thinks the boy is his."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "Then the mother has to disappear before the result arrives. Do exactly as I say."
Tanya ends the call and smiles at her reflection in the glass.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Bye-bye, Meera."
A charity dinner. Bunty, in a waiter's jacket and a fake moustache, balances a tray of canapés.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Agent Bunty. Mission: follow Tanya. Rule one: never eat on duty."
He eats a canapé. Then another.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Rule two: rule one is cancelled."

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "The records room, eleven o'clock. Make sure the door locks from outside."
Bunty leans closer to listen and his fake moustache drops into the soup tureen.

blocks.speaker: GUEST
blocks.text: "Waiter, there's a moustache in my soup."

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "It's French cuisine, madam. Very rare. Moustache bisque."

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Wait. I know you. You're her cousin!"
Bunty flings the tray in the air and sprints out through the kitchen doors.
A crash of plates and a chef's scream.
Tanya picks up Bunty's dropped earpiece and slips it into her purse.
Meera opens an old tin trunk and lifts out her father's leather diary.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Papa wrote everything down. Everything."
She flips to the week of the wedding. One page has been torn out.
On the next page, pressed into the paper, the faint dents of the missing words.
Meera rubs a pencil over the dents. Letters rise out of the grey.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "The forger lives inside the Raichand house. He has a key to the records room."
The doorbell rings.
Arjun stands at the door, holding a hospital envelope.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "The result came. He's my son, Meera."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "He was your son the night your mother threw me out. You chose not to ask."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "I didn't know you were pregnant. If I had known..."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "You'd have stood up for me? For the baby, but never for me?"
Arjun has no answer. Kabir peeks out from behind the bedroom door.

blocks.speaker: KABIR
blocks.text: "Mumma, is the sad man staying for dinner?"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "No, baby. He was just leaving."
Meera closes the door. On the table, the diary page glows under the lamp: RECORDS ROOM.
Meera slips into a dusty room stacked with old files, a torch in her hand.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Five years of lies. They have to be here somewhere."
She pulls a file marked SHARMA TEXTILES. Inside: sheets of practice signatures.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Papa's signature. Copied fifty times."
The heavy door slams. A key turns in the lock.
Meera runs to the door and pulls the handle. It doesn't move.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Who's there? Open the door!"

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Looking for the truth, Meera? It burns so easily."
A match strikes. Liquid splashes against the door.
Smoke curls in under the door. An orange glow grows in the gap.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Tanya! Open this door! Tanya!"
Flames climb the old shelves. Papers curl and blacken.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Kabir... I promised I'd be home."
She clutches the forged file to her chest and sinks to the floor, coughing.
The roar of fire. A window bursts in the heat.
Through the smoke, Meera's torch flickers and goes out.

episodes.logline: Arjun pulls Meera out of the fire, and at his engagement party a five-year-old recording exposes who forged her father's signature.

blocks.text: A thunderous crash as the burning door splinters inward.
Arjun smashes through the flaming door with a fire extinguisher.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Meera! Meera, where are you?"
Through the smoke: Meera on the floor, the file still in her arms.
Arjun lifts her and carries her out through the flames.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "The file... don't let it burn."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "I let you burn once. Never again."
Outside on the lawn, he lays her on the grass. Fire engines wail in the distance.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Tanya locked the door. Your mother sent her."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "My mother?"
Arjun looks up at the mansion. In an upstairs window, Savitri lets the curtain fall.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Tomorrow is your engagement party. Make sure everyone is there."
Chandeliers. A banner: ARJUN WEDS TANYA.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "Tonight, everyone will finally see who the real Mrs. Raichand is."

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "And that fire took care of the past. Smile, beta."
The music stops. The ballroom doors open.
Meera walks in, a bandage on her arm, in a red sari. Kabir holds her hand.

blocks.speaker: TANYA
blocks.text: "You... you should be dead."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Careful, Tanya. That sounds like a confession."

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Ladies and gentlemen, a short film. I directed it five years ago. By accident."
The giant screen behind the stage flickers on.
On screen: shaky phone footage of a dark study, five years ago.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "It's done. The papers you forged worked. Not one person doubted them."
A gasp ripples through three hundred guests.

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "That's fake! That girl made it on a computer!"

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Then let the man who forged the papers tell them."
Mehta, the old family lawyer, steps out of the crowd with his head bowed.

blocks.speaker: MEHTA
blocks.text: "I forged Sharma-ji's signature. Savitri-ji paid me. She wanted his company and his daughter gone."

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "Maa... is it true?"

blocks.speaker: SAVITRI
blocks.text: "I did it for you! That girl was never good enough for this family!"
Police sirens outside. Boots on marble.

blocks.speaker: INSPECTOR
blocks.text: "Savitri Raichand, Tanya Kapoor, you are under arrest for fraud and attempted murder."
Handcuffs click on Savitri's wrists. Tanya tries to run and slips on a fallen rose.

blocks.speaker: BUNTY
blocks.text: "Karma, Tanya. Also, the floor is very slippery. Sorry."
Savitri is led past Meera. They lock eyes. Savitri looks away first.
Arjun kneels in front of Meera, holding out her old wedding dupatta.

blocks.speaker: ARJUN
blocks.text: "I kept it for five years. Marry me again, Meera. Let me be his father."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "The Meera you threw out died in that rain, Arjun. You're talking to a stranger."

blocks.speaker: KABIR
blocks.text: "Mumma, why is the sad man kneeling?"
Arjun lowers his head. The dupatta slips from his hands.
Meera stands alone at the terrace railing. The city glitters below.

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "It's over, Papa. Your name is clean."
Her phone buzzes. The screen reads: UNKNOWN NUMBER.
She answers.

blocks.speaker: MR. SHARMA
blocks.text: "Meera... beta, it's me."

blocks.speaker: MEERA
blocks.text: "Papa? You're awake? After five years?"

blocks.speaker: MR. SHARMA
blocks.text: "Listen to me. Don't trust Arjun. He knew. He knew about the papers all along."
Meera turns slowly. Behind the glass door, Arjun is watching her.
The line goes dead.
Freeze on Meera's face. Cut to black.
